# Setup Environment 
```{r setup, include=T}
source('0_functions.R', echo=F) 
library(survival)
library(INLAjoint)
library(INLA)
library(brms)
```

## Lung dataset example
```{r e1, warning=FALSE, eval=T}
dta = lung[,c("time","status")]
dta = dta[complete.cases(dta),]

km_fit0 = survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ 1, data = dta)
if(!file.exists("km_fit.rds")) {
km_fit = posterior_draw(formula = Surv(time, status) ~ 1,
                      data = dta,
                      n_print = 1000,burn_in = 1000,
                      n_mcmc =5000, verbose = T, 
                      thin = 1, calibration = T)
saveRDS(km_fit, file = "km_fit.rds")
}
km_fit = readRDS("km_fit.rds")
```

```{r p1, warning=FALSE, eval=T}
par(mfrow = c(2, 2),mar = c(3, 3, 4, 1))
#
plot(km_fit$rmb_splines$time_grid,km_fit$rmb_splines$Du_all[,1],type="l",lwd=0, main="(a)",ylab="", xlab="",cex.axis=1, cex.main=1.5)
for(c in 1:ncol(km_fit$rmb_splines$Du_all)){
  lines(km_fit$rmb_splines$time_grid,km_fit$rmb_splines$Du_all[,c],col=c,lty=c, lwd=2)
}
#
plot(km_fit$rmb_splines$time_grid,km_fit$rmb_splines$u_all[,1],type="l",lwd=0, main="(b)",ylab="", xlab="",cex.axis=1, cex.main=1.5, ylim=max(km_fit$rmb_splines$time_grid)*c(min(km_fit$rmb_splines$u_all),max(km_fit$rmb_splines$u_all)))
for(c in 1:ncol(km_fit$rmb_splines$Du_all)){
  lines(km_fit$rmb_splines$time_grid,max(km_fit$rmb_splines$time_grid)*km_fit$rmb_splines$u_all[,c],col=c,lty=c, lwd=2)
}
#
lch = summary.baselineLogCumulativeHazard(km_fit)
plot(km_fit$rmb_splines$time_grid,lch$spline_summary$base$mean,type="l", main="(c)",ylab="", xlab="",cex.axis=1, cex.main=1.5, lwd=2, col="red",
     ylim=c(min(lch$spline_summary$base$joint_band$lower_CI),
            max(lch$spline_summary$base$joint_band$upper_CI))
     )
lines(km_fit$rmb_splines$time_grid,lch$spline_summary$base$joint_band$lower_CI,lwd=2,lty=2,col="red")
lines(km_fit$rmb_splines$time_grid,lch$spline_summary$base$joint_band$upper_CI,lwd=2,lty=2,col="red")
#
plot(km_fit0, lty = 1, col = c("blue"), lwd = 3.5, 
     conf.int = TRUE, conf.int.style = "bands",
     main="(d)",ylab="", xlab="",cex.axis=1, cex.main=1.5 )
lines(km_fit$rmb_splines$time_grid,exp(-exp(lch$spline_summary$base$mean)),lwd=2,lty=1,col="red")
lines(km_fit$rmb_splines$time_grid,exp(-exp(lch$spline_summary$base$joint_band$lower_CI)),lwd=2,lty=2,col="red")
lines(km_fit$rmb_splines$time_grid,exp(-exp(lch$spline_summary$base$joint_band$upper_CI)),lwd=2,lty=2,col="red")
legend("topright", legend = c("KM", "Cox-PG"), col = c("blue", "red"), lty = 1, lwd = 2)
```

## Lung dataset example, Weibull model
```{r e1.1, warning=FALSE, eval=T}
dta = lung[,c("time","status")]
dta = dta[complete.cases(dta),]

km_fit0 = survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ 1, data = dta)
if(!file.exists("km_fit2.rds")) {
km_fit2 = weibull_posterior_draw(formula = Surv(time, status) ~ 1,
                      data = dta,
                      n_print = 1000,burn_in = 1000,
                      n_mcmc =5000, verbose = T, 
                      thin = 1, calibration = T)

}
km_fit2 = readRDS("km_fit2.rds")
```

## Lung dataset example, Weibull model and sex strata
```{r e1.2, warning=FALSE, eval=T}
dta = lung[,c("time","status","sex")]
dta$sex = as.factor(dta$sex)
dta = dta[complete.cases(dta),]

km_fit0 = survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ sex, data = dta)
if(!file.exists("km_fit3.rds")) {
km_fit3 = weibull_posterior_draw(formula = Surv(time, status) ~ 1,
                      data = dta,hazard_group = "sex",
                      n_print = 1000,burn_in = 1000,
                      n_mcmc =5000, verbose = T, 
                      thin = 1, calibration = T)
saveRDS(km_fit3, file = "km_fit3.rds")
}
km_fit3 = readRDS("km_fit3.rds")
```


```{r p1.2, warning=FALSE, eval=T}
par(mfrow = c(2, 2),mar = c(3, 3, 4, 1))
#
plot(km_fit2$rmb_splines$time_grid,km_fit$rmb_splines$Du_all[,1],type="l",lwd=0, main="(a)",ylab="", xlab="",cex.axis=1, cex.main=1.5)
for(c in 1:ncol(km_fit$rmb_splines$Du_all)){
  lines(km_fit$rmb_splines$time_grid,km_fit$rmb_splines$Du_all[,c],col=c,lty=c, lwd=2)
}
#
plot(km_fit3$rmb_splines$time_grid,km_fit$rmb_splines$u_all[,1],type="l",lwd=0, main="(b)",ylab="", xlab="",cex.axis=1, cex.main=1.5, ylim=max(km_fit$rmb_splines$time_grid)*c(min(km_fit$rmb_splines$u_all),max(km_fit$rmb_splines$u_all)))
for(c in 1:ncol(km_fit$rmb_splines$Du_all)){
  lines(km_fit$rmb_splines$time_grid,max(km_fit$rmb_splines$time_grid)*km_fit$rmb_splines$u_all[,c],col=c,lty=c, lwd=2)
}
#
lch = summary.baselineLogCumulativeHazard(km_fit3)
plot(km_fit3$rmb_splines$time_grid,lch$spline_summary$`1`$mean,type="l", main="(c)",ylab="", xlab="",cex.axis=1, cex.main=1.5, lwd=2, col="red",
     ylim=c(min(lch$spline_summary$`1`$joint_band$lower_CI),
            max(lch$spline_summary$`1`$joint_band$upper_CI))
     )
lines(km_fit2$rmb_splines$time_grid,lch$spline_summary$`1`$joint_band$lower_CI,lwd=2,lty=2,col="red")
lines(km_fit2$rmb_splines$time_grid,lch$spline_summary$`1`$joint_band$upper_CI,lwd=2,lty=2,col="red")
lines(km_fit3$rmb_splines$time_grid,lch$spline_summary$`2`$mean,lwd=2,lty=2,col="orange")
lines(km_fit2$rmb_splines$time_grid,lch$spline_summary$`2`$joint_band$lower_CI,lwd=2,lty=2,col="orange")
lines(km_fit2$rmb_splines$time_grid,lch$spline_summary$`2`$joint_band$upper_CI,lwd=2,lty=2,col="orange")
#
plot(km_fit0, lty = 1, col = c("blue","green"), lwd = 3.5, 
     conf.int = TRUE, conf.int.style = "bands",
     main="(d)",ylab="", xlab="",cex.axis=1, cex.main=1.5 )
lines(km_fit2$rmb_splines$time_grid,exp(-exp(lch$spline_summary$`1`$mean)),lwd=2,lty=1,col="red")
lines(km_fit2$rmb_splines$time_grid,exp(-exp(lch$spline_summary$`1`$joint_band$lower_CI)),lwd=2,lty=2,col="red")
lines(km_fit2$rmb_splines$time_grid,exp(-exp(lch$spline_summary$`1`$joint_band$upper_CI)),lwd=2,lty=2,col="red")
lines(km_fit2$rmb_splines$time_grid,exp(-exp(lch$spline_summary$`2`$mean)),lwd=2,lty=1,col="orange")
lines(km_fit2$rmb_splines$time_grid,exp(-exp(lch$spline_summary$`2`$joint_band$lower_CI)),lwd=2,lty=2,col="orange")
lines(km_fit2$rmb_splines$time_grid,exp(-exp(lch$spline_summary$`2`$joint_band$upper_CI)),lwd=2,lty=2,col="orange")
legend("topright", legend = c("KM","KM","Cox-PG","Cox-PG"), col = c("blue","green", "red","orange"), lty = 1, lwd = 2)
```
